acceptanceCriteria: One read-only command emits a bundle directory or archive plus a manifest listing each included receipt with kind, sha256, the bound repository revision and every NOT_RUN or NOT_PRODUCED axis it carries; missing receipts are listed as absent, never synthesized.
A verifier recomputes every digest from the bundle alone in a fresh clone and reports match or the exact mismatch; the verifier needs no network and no Corvint index.

A spec with numbered requirements records the manifest schema, the inclusion rules and the non-goals (no signing, no publication, no authority), cross-referenced from release-artifact-integrity-v0.md.
The bundle for one dogfood change on this repository is produced and verified and the receipt is recorded in docs/BUILD-LOG.md.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the owner's review of JetBrains Air (jetbrains.com/air, JetBrains blog 2026-09-22): the owner accepted the idea for 1.0. Air is a cloud/IDE orchestration platform; only its contracts transfer. Invariant 7 (AGENTS.md) still holds: no hosted service, UI, daemon or network dependency on the local path. Air Governance sells auditability, cost attribution and accountability and asks which agent output requires human review. Corvint's content-addressed receipts are exactly that evidence but live as separate files with separate readers. One exported bundle with a manifest lets an external governance or audit system ingest them without learning each format. Builds on docs/specs/release-artifact-integrity-v0.md (ARTIFACT-RDY-V0-006..009 publication receipt reader). The bundle is data: it grants no authority and is never an input to ranking or evidence.

completion.reason: Delivered by PR #129 (RCB-V0-001..007: `corvint cem export` writes a content-addressed receipt bundle; `script/verify-receipt-bundle.sh` recomputes digests with POSIX tools, no network or index). docs/specs/receipt-bundle-v0.md records the schema, inclusion rules and non-goals. Criterion 4: BUILD-LOG 2026-09-23 V1-0197 entry, bundle for PR #122's CEM, manifest sha256 65d16c73974d8b09f1882fe38617592cc201ffbfebb920ac134f4a9c110564da, verified. The two ticket deviations (GOC-V0-010 full-gate receipt instead of the gate ledger; directory only, no archive) were accepted by the owner in decision 0376 (PR #140). make gate NOT_RUN for this ticket.

title: receipts: export a content-addressed receipt bundle (CEM, witness, dogfood, gate ledger) for external audit and governance ingestion
